correctness.rationale: Every inequality and equality case is proved by coloring-class support bounds and exact equality constraints. The quantitative conclusion follows by controlling off-peak squared masses and excluding any opposite-sign or nonedge pair at the stated strict threshold. For q=1 the unique selected class makes that exclusion vacuous. A deterministic independent enumerator tested 810 graphs and 23,936 directions; tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Complete intrinsic minimum-width formula and exhaustive normal recovery of all maximum cliques on the large natural weakly perfect class; additionally proves a dimension-independent error modulus for all near minimizers. This strengthens a single-number invariant into exact combinatorial recovery and a robust local geometric statement for every size of perfect graph and every finite poset chain polytope. It is not a table lookup or an immediate restatement of facial or inradius results.
